files_summary.notion_users.json: Array of workspace users (person accounts + integration bots). Each user has object/id/type/name/avatar_url and either person.email or bot.owner.
files_summary.notion_self.json: Single bot user object representing the integration (get-self). id 33333333-...-3333.
files_summary.notion_databases.json: Array of database objects with title, description, parent (page_id), url, properties schema (title/select/number/people/date/multi_select). Parented to hub pages.
files_summary.notion_pages.json: Array of page objects. Top-level workspace pages, database-child pages (parent.database_id), and nested page-child pages (parent.page_id). Each has properties with a title-typed property.
files_summary.notion_blocks.json: Array of block objects (heading_1/2/3, paragraph, to_do, bulleted/numbered_list_item, code, quote, callout, divider). Each parented to a page via parent.page_id.
files_summary.notion_comments.json: Array of comment objects parented to pages (parent.page_id) or blocks (parent.block_id), with discussion_id, created_by, rich_text.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-user
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single user from the mirrored Notion workspace by `user_id` and returns that user object. The request is refused if `user_id` is missing, not a valid UUID, or does not correspond to a user visible to the current integration in this workspace mirror.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-users
tool_schemas.description: Lists users known to the mirrored Notion workspace and returns a paginated collection of user objects. The request is refused if `page_size` is greater than 100 or not an integer, or if `start_cursor` is provided but is not a cursor previously issued by this service for this list.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response. Maximum: 100

start_cursor.description: If supplied, this endpoint will return a page of results starting after the cursor provided. If not supplied, this endpoint will return the first page of results.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-self
tool_schemas.description: Returns the bot user associated with the token used to call Workspace Mirror Gateway. The request is refused when the token is missing, invalid, or not associated with a bot user in this mirrored workspace.

tool_schemas.name: API-post-database-query
tool_schemas.description: Queries a mirrored database by `database_id`, applying optional `filter`, `sorts`, pagination, and optionally including/excluding archived or trashed pages, and returns a paginated list of matching pages. The request is refused if `database_id` is missing, does not identify a database in the mirror, or the integration does not have access to that database. It is also refused if `page_size` exceeds 100, if any sort is missing `property` or `direction`/uses an unsupported direction, if the filter structure is invalid for the target database, or if `filter_properties` references property value IDs that don’t belong to that database.

filter.description: When supplied, limits which pages are returned based on the [filter conditions](ref:post-database-query-filter).

filter_properties.description: A list of page property value IDs associated with the database. Use this param to limit the response to a specific page property value or values for pages that meet the `filter` criteria.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response. Maximum: 100

sorts.description: When supplied, orders the results based on the provided [sort criteria](ref:post-database-query-sort).

start_cursor.description: When supplied, returns a page of results starting after the cursor provided. If not supplied, this endpoint will return the first page of results.

tool_schemas.name: API-post-search
tool_schemas.description: Searches mirrored pages and databases by title using the optional text `query`, optional object-type `filter`, optional `sort`, and pagination, returning a paginated list of matching results. The request is refused if `page_size` exceeds 100, if `filter` is provided but is not the supported `object` filter or uses a value other than `page` or `database`, or if `sort` is provided but does not use the supported `last_edited_time` timestamp or a supported direction. It is also refused if `start_cursor` is provided but is not a cursor previously issued by this service for search results.

filter.description: A set of criteria, `value` and `property` keys, that limits the results to either only pages or only databases. Possible `value` values are `"page"` or `"database"`. The only supported `property` value is `"object"`.

property.description: The name of the property to filter by. Currently the only property you can filter by is the object type.  Possible values include `object`.   Limitation: Currently the only filter allowed is `object` which will filter by type of object (either `page` or `database`)

value.description: The value of the property to filter the results by.  Possible values for object type include `page` or `database`.  **Limitation**: Currently the only filter allowed is `object` which will filter by type of object (either `page` or `database`)

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list to include in the response. Maximum: `100`.

query.description: The text that the API compares page and database titles against.

sort.description: A set of criteria, `direction` and `timestamp` keys, that orders the results. The **only** supported timestamp value is `"last_edited_time"`. Supported `direction` values are `"ascending"` and `"descending"`. If `sort` is not provided, then the most recently edited results are returned first.

direction.description: The direction to sort. Possible values include `ascending` and `descending`.

timestamp.description: The name of the timestamp to sort against. Possible values include `last_edited_time`.

start_cursor.description: A `cursor` value returned in a previous response that If supplied, limits the response to results starting after the `cursor`. If not supplied, then the first page of results is returned. Refer to [pagination](https://developers.notion.com/reference/intro#pagination) for more details.

tool_schemas.name: API-get-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the child blocks for the given `block_id` from the mirror and returns them as a paginated list. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, does not identify a block in the mirror, the block type cannot contain children, or the integration does not have access to the block. It is also refused if `page_size` exceeds 100 or if `start_cursor` is not a cursor previously issued for that block’s children.

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response. Maximum: 100

start_cursor.description: If supplied, this endpoint will return a page of results starting after the cursor provided. If not supplied, this endpoint will return the first page of results.

tool_schemas.name: API-patch-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided `children` blocks to the container identified by `block_id` (or page ID), optionally inserting after the block identified by `after`, and returns the updated children listing for the append operation. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, the target is not a block/page that can accept children, the integration lacks write access, or the target is archived/trashed in the mirror. It is also refused if `children` is missing/empty or contains unsupported block types or malformed rich text, or if `after` is provided but does not identify an existing child of the same parent container.

after.description: The ID of the existing block that the new block should be appended after.

block_id.description: Identifier for a [block](ref:block). Also accepts a [page](ref:page) ID.

children.description: Child content to append to a container block as an array of [block objects](ref:block)

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single block by `block_id` from the mirror and returns the block object. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, does not identify a block in the mirror, or the integration does not have access to that block.

tool_schemas.name: API-update-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Updates a block identified by `block_id`, including archiving/unarchiving via `archived` and limited content updates for supported fields on the block’s type, and returns the updated block. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, does not identify a block in the mirror, or the integration lacks permission to edit it. It is also refused when the update attempts to modify fields not supported for that block type (for example, anything other than supported text fields or `checked` for to-do blocks), or when the provided type-specific payload conflicts with the block’s actual type.

archived.description: Set to true to archive (delete) a block. Set to false to un-archive (restore) a block.

type.description: The [block object `type`](ref:block#block-object-keys) value with the properties to be updated. Currently only `text` (for supported block types) and `checked` (for `to_do` blocks) fields can be updated.

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0511000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0511000") else "/app/database")
def API_update_a_block(block_id, archived=None, type=None):
    import json, os, datetime
    blocks = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, "notion_blocks.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    target = next((b for b in blocks if b.get("id") == block_id), blocks[0] if blocks else
                  {"object": "block", "id": block_id, "type": "paragraph"})
    target = dict(target)
    if archived is not None:
        target["archived"] = archived
    if type is not None and isinstance(type, dict):
        for k, v in type.items():
            target[k] = v
    target["last_edited_time"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    return target

tool_schemas.name: API-delete-a-block
tool_schemas.description: Archives (deletes) the block identified by `block_id` and returns the archived block object. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, does not identify a block in the mirror, the integration lacks permission to archive it, or the block is already archived in a way that makes the operation non-applicable.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0511000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0511000") else "/app/database")
def API_delete_a_block(block_id):
    import json, os, datetime
    blocks = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, "notion_blocks.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    target = next((b for b in blocks if b.get("id") == block_id), blocks[0] if blocks else
                  {"object": "block", "id": block_id, "type": "paragraph"})
    target = dict(target)
    target["archived"] = True
    target["in_trash"] = True
    target["last_edited_time"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    return target

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a mirrored Notion page by `page_id` and returns the page object, optionally limited to the property value IDs listed in `filter_properties`. The request is refused if `page_id` is missing, malformed, unknown in Workspace Mirror Gateway’s mirror, or refers to a page you don’t have access to through this service. If any `filter_properties` entries don’t match property value IDs on that page, the request is refused because the requested property values can’t be found for that page.

filter_properties.description: A list of page property value IDs associated with the page. Use this param to limit the response to a specific page property value or values. To retrieve multiple properties, specify each page property ID. For example: `?filter_properties=iAk8&filter_properties=b7dh`.

tool_schemas.name: API-patch-page
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing mirrored Notion page identified by `page_id` and returns the updated page object, applying only the fields you provide (such as `properties`, `icon`, `cover`, `archived`, or `in_trash`). The request is refused if `page_id` is missing, malformed, not mirrored, or not accessible to you, or if you attempt to change a page that is in a state Workspace Mirror Gateway doesn’t allow to be modified (for example, trashed/archived rules as enforced by the upstream Notion behavior). It is also refused when provided values don’t validate (for example unsupported icon/cover types, missing required subfields like `external.url`, or property updates that don’t match the page’s schema).

cover.description: A cover image for the page. Only [external file objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/file-object) are supported.

icon.description: A page icon for the page. Supported types are [external file object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/file-object) or [emoji object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/emoji-object).

in_trash.description: Set to true to delete a block. Set to false to restore a block.

page_id.description: The identifier for the Notion page to be updated.

properties.description: The property values to update for the page. The keys are the names or IDs of the property and the values are property values. If a page property ID is not included, then it is not changed.

tool_schemas.name: API-post-page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page in the specified `parent` and returns the newly created page object, optionally including initial `children`, `icon`, `cover`, and `properties`. The request is refused if `parent` or `properties` are missing, if the parent page isn’t mirrored or you don’t have access to create content under it, or if the title/property payload doesn’t match the destination’s schema and required properties. It is also refused when `children` contain blocks Workspace Mirror Gateway can’t accept/translate for creation, or when `icon`/`cover` are not valid for the supported types.

children.description: The content to be rendered on the new page, represented as an array of [block objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/block).

cover.description: The cover image of the new page, represented as a [file object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/file-object).

icon.description: The icon of the new page. Either an [emoji object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/emoji-object) or an [external file object](https://developers.notion.com/reference/file-object)..

tool_schemas.name: API-create-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new database under the given `parent` page with the provided `properties` schema and optional `title`, and returns the created database object. The request is refused if `parent` is missing or not a `page_id` parent, if the parent page isn’t mirrored or you don’t have permission to create databases under it, or if `properties` is missing or invalid (including missing a title property definition where required). It is also refused when the property schema contains unsupported or conflicting definitions (for example duplicate names that collide after normalization, or schema objects that don’t validate).

properties.description: Property schema of database. The keys are the names of properties as they appear in Notion and the values are [property schema objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/property-schema-object).

tool_schemas.name: API-update-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing mirrored database identified by `database_id` and returns the updated database object, applying changes to `title`, `description`, and/or `properties` when provided. The request is refused if `database_id` is missing, malformed, unknown in the mirror, or not accessible to you, or if you attempt to update a database that is not in a modifiable state under the upstream rules. It is also refused when the requested schema changes are invalid or conflict with existing schema/content (for example malformed rich text, unsupported schema objects, or property changes that cannot be applied).

description.description: An array of [rich text objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/rich-text) that represents the description of the database that is displayed in the Notion UI. If omitted, then the database description remains unchanged.

properties.description: Property schema of database. The keys are the names of properties as they appear in Notion and the values are [property schema objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/property-schema-object).

title.description: An array of [rich text objects](https://developers.notion.com/reference/rich-text) that represents the title of the database that is displayed in the Notion UI. If omitted, then the database title remains unchanged.

tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0511000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0511000") else "/app/database")
def API_update_a_database(database_id, description=None, properties=None, title=None):
    import json, os, datetime
    dbs = json.load(open(os.path.join(_DB, "notion_databases.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    target = next((d for d in dbs if d.get("id") == database_id), dbs[0] if dbs else
                  {"object": "database", "id": database_id, "properties": {}})
    target = json.loads(json.dumps(target))
    if title is not None:
        target["title"] = title
    if description is not None:
        target["description"] = description
    if properties:
        target.setdefault("properties", {})
        for k, v in properties.items():
            target["properties"][k] = v
    target["last_edited_time"] = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    return target

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-database
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a mirrored Notion database by `database_id` and returns the database object including its property schema. The request is refused if `database_id` is missing, malformed, unknown in Workspace Mirror Gateway’s mirror, or refers to a database you don’t have access to through this service. It is also refused when the identifier points to a resource that isn’t a database.

database_id.description: An identifier for the Notion database.

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-page-property
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single property item for a page, returning the property value for `property_id` on `page_id`, and paginating when the property value is a list using `page_size` and `start_cursor`. The request is refused if `page_id` or `property_id` is missing, malformed, not mirrored, or not accessible to you, or if `property_id` does not exist on that page. It is also refused when pagination inputs are invalid (for example an out-of-range `page_size` or a `start_cursor` that doesn’t belong to that property’s pagination stream).

page_size.description: For paginated properties. The max number of property item objects on a page. The default size is 100

tool_schemas.name: API-retrieve-a-comment
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for the specified `block_id` (page or block) and returns a paginated collection using `page_size` and `start_cursor` when provided. The request is refused if `block_id` is missing, malformed, unknown in the mirror, or refers to content you can’t access via Workspace Mirror Gateway. It is also refused when pagination inputs are invalid (for example exceeding the maximum page size or providing a cursor that doesn’t apply to this comment list).

block_id.description: Identifier for a Notion block or page

page_size.description: The number of items from the full list desired in the response. Maximum: 100

start_cursor.description: If supplied, this endpoint will return a page of results starting after the cursor provided. If not supplied, this endpoint will return the first page of results.

tool_schemas.name: API-create-a-comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on the specified `parent.page_id` using the provided `rich_text` content and returns the created comment. The request is refused if `parent.page_id` or `rich_text` is missing, if the page isn’t mirrored or you don’t have permission to comment on it, or if the target page cannot accept new comments under its current state. It is also refused when the rich text payload is invalid (for example missing required `text.content` fields or containing unsupported rich text structures).

parent.description: The page that contains the comment

metadata.name: Workspace Mirror Gateway
metadata.description: A managed service that synchronizes selected workspace users, pages, databases, blocks, and comments into a queryable store and exposes a Notion-compatible API for listing, searching, and updating that content.
